name: 通話中のカメラと会話の操作
prompt:
Create a crisp, flat Japanese call-controls toolbar at exactly 390×96 pixels. The native 390×96 preview is the ground truth for layout, icon meaning, wording and typography. The source crop is only context for the five call-control symbols; do not copy its gray overlay, blue microphone states, red hang-up color or lack of labels. Use the prior white neutral audio settings candidate only as a surface-color reference.

The user requests no tint colors. Keep the page pure white #FFFFFF. Remove the four pale mint button fills: make those four pill-shaped controls white with a fine neutral #E2E8E5 outline. Do not use mint, pastel, tinted fills, gradients, glows or shadows. Keep the first four icons forest green #047857. Preserve the final 通話終了 button as a solid dark green #064E3B action with its white handset icon; it is a purposeful primary call-ending control, not a tinted surface. All five labels are neutral gray #6E6E6E. There is no hyperlink in the native preview, so do not color any label blue and do not add a link.

Match the native layout exactly on a 390×96 white canvas. Five controls sit in one evenly spaced row. Button bounds are x16, 90, 164, 238, and 312; each is y8, 62×46, radius 23. Their green icons are centered in the first four buttons, and the fifth handset is white and centered in its dark-green button. Place the neutral labels below the buttons at y65, height 16, Meiryo Regular 12px, centered in 66px areas starting at x14, 88, 162, 236, and 310. Preserve exact labels and order: カメラ, マイク, 会話, 一緒に遊ぶ, 通話終了. Preserve the icon meanings and simple native line style: video camera, microphone, speech bubble, people, and telephone handset.

Keep the design compact and aligned to the source preview. No added title, device frame, wallpaper, extra copy, extra controls, or decorative elements. Return only the finished flat toolbar at its full 390×96 aspect ratio with no surrounding margin.
reviewNotes: White neutral controls with no tinted fills and green call-ending action are preserved. v001 does not match the original source icon silhouettes: it uses an open camera, outlined chat/group symbols, and a diagonal handset instead of the source crossed-out camera, filled chat bubble, gamepad, and original handset. Keep needs-correction for one icon-focused pass.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
